released_cli.launch_policy: SDK-owned stdio process using the direct native binary, no external server or npm launcher for process fencing
released_cli.args_scope: Proof isolation. F00 must explicitly configure production MCPs and adapted skills. Do not copy disabled tools as the product profile.

authentication.mechanism: Official runtime resolves its existing supported login. No token extraction, explicit token, login flow or forwarded token environment variables.

models.unavailable_required_model_test: e01-deliberately-unavailable-model rejected as invalid_model without child start or fallback

create_and_resume.autopilot: Leave default enabled; do not lower max_continues below five. No Autopilot continuation stress proof was performed.
create_and_resume.large_output: F00 must configure the released LargeToolOutputConfig with active-project .proscenium/tool-output/ directory. Spill behaviour not exercised.
create_and_resume.skill_directories: Explicit Proscenium-adapted skill roots. Skill discovery/preloading not exercised.

context.client_turn_id: Application request ID, correlation only, not deduplication
context.attachments: Image file attachments in role order followed by extension_context
context.selected_child_context_delivery: on_user_prompt_submitted -> additionalContext with immutable trusted context JSON, including for agentId/parentAgentId-attributed child hooks

stop_barrier.api_stability: experimental queue RPC, exact-version compatibility test required
stop_barrier.pause_semantics: Queued lane only, exclusive non-idempotent acquisition, no automatic release, not evidence that immediate steering or live children are stopped
stop_barrier.cancel_active: session.abort() exactly once for the durable Stop control
stop_barrier.verified_race: Immediate Steer held at completed root hook moved into paused native queue, native idle observed, abort acknowledged, queue empty before barrier, no later deferred turn, cold non-continuing resume stayed empty
stop_barrier.race_withdrawal_note: Abort had already emptied the paused queue. Do not relabel withdrawal false as removal success.
stop_barrier.force_fence: Public CopilotClient.force_stop() kills/reaps only its directly spawned native process; wait for confirmed process exit. Never use a shared or unrelated runtime.
stop_barrier.cold_resume: Only on explicit Resume, register callbacks/tools/context first, use continue_pending_work=False and inspect pending items before admission
stop_barrier.unhandled_first_message_crash: A newly created session containing only a paused, unconsumed first message was missing after forced runtime exit. Preserve native_session_missing, never recreate or resend automatically.
stop_barrier.limit: No live-child Stop, genuinely lost transport ACK or pending external-tool resume proof in this allocation

not_product_completion: No backend route, caller-capability or publication path-validator implementation
SQLite evidence replay is not live application persistence or restart acceptance
No live-child stop/recovery, actual lost transport acknowledgement, Autopilot continuation or large-output stress proof
No Blender, Unity, GPU, external publishing or model-service changes
